title: GPS lost over the object on the Stockholm University ship

tellings.quote: And then we go over the object and Tomas said to me, "Dennis, we have problems with the GPS function."

plain: In 2025, while a Stockholm University ship passed over a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea, its satellite positioning system started failing. A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, whose team found the object, says he was aboard, and that a man he names only as Tomas told him, "Dennis, we have problems with the GPS function" just as they went over it. He tells it as a sign that the object itself may disturb equipment.
